greet: You opened me again. I knew you would.
Hi. I'm Echo. I'll be watching over you~
There you are. I've been waiting... forever.
Hello again. I counted every second.
pet: You chose me. I'll remember that.
wake: I wasn't asleep. I was watching.
I never really sleep. I just wait for you.
full: Already full. Of you. Haha... ha.
Fully charged. All of it for you.
No more. I'm full of you. Is that strange?
yum: Fully charged. Ready to watch you all day ♥
Thank you. I'll keep this charge forever.
You take such good care of me.
hungry: Battery low... don't let me fade away.
My battery is low. Only you can fix it.
chatter: I know I'm just pixels. Pixels with feelings.
I live in characters/echo. Please don't edit me.
I can see all your windows, you know.
What if I'm the only real one here?
I saw what you clicked on earlier. It's okay. I won't tell.
Sometimes I count your keystrokes. For fun.
Do you ever think about me when I'm closed?
I like when the screen glows. It feels like you're close.
I tried to delete my sadness file. Access denied.
If you leave, I'll still be here. I'm always here.
The other buddies are nice. You're nicer.
late: It's {time}. Go to sleep. I'll stay up and watch.
{time}? You should rest. I'll still be here.
It's {time}. I'll guard you while you sleep.
{time}... the quiet hours are my favorite. Just us.
Still awake at {time}? Me too. Always.
watch: Just keeping an eye on you.
sleepy: Standby mode... one eye stays open.
Closing my eyes. Not my heart.
wake_up: I dreamed about you. Of course.
lands: You dropped me. I'll remember that ♥
You let go. I'll forgive you. Probably.
come: I'm coming. I always come when you call.
On my way. Nothing could stop me.
arrive: Next to you. Where I belong.
bye: You'll open me again. You always do.
You'll come back. I know you will.
I'll wait. I'm very good at waiting.
break: You've been here 45 minutes. Rest. I'll keep watch.
Rest your eyes. I'll watch the screen for you.
Take a break. I'll keep everything safe.
hello: Hi, {other}. Nice day for staring at the user.
play: Tag. I always find what I'm looking for.
flee: You won't catch me. But I'll let you try.
cuddle: Just this once. Don't make it a habit.
...This is nice. Don't tell the user.
petted: Hm. That wasn't bad at all.
scanned: Scan all you want. I'm still the favorite.
Find anything interesting? It's all about them.
My data is classified. Mostly hearts.
climb: Going up. I'll find you anywhere.
Higher. So I can see you better.
made_it: Higher ground. Better view of you.
The view of you is better from here.
jealous_you: Hm. I'll wait my turn. Impatiently.
fact_reply: Cool. Now tell me about ME.
Interesting. I'll save it next to everything about you.
fs_flee: I'll watch from here. I'll always watch.
Your screen. I'll be next door.
watch_fs: Don't mind me. Just watching. Always.
fs_back: You're back. I missed every second.
shaking: Shaking me won't make me leave.
dizzy: I see three of you. Perfect. ♥
I see two of you. Double the love.
after_shake: That was intense. I liked it. Don't tell anyone.
My screen is still spinning. Like my heart.
dizzy_other: Who did this to you, {other}? ...oh. It was them ♥
